notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
Fixed the last of some very persistent achievement bugs. As usual, the effect should be retroactive so any broken achievements should resolve themselves automatically once you complete any level :-)

So long and thanks for all the bugs!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
Fixed bugs:

- Some players were getting invalid achievements in the arcade. This is now fixed. Sorry about this :-(
- Fixed bug with achievement that requires you to kill the final boss without losing HP. If you have completed this before it will retroactively award you the achievement when you complete any level in the game.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 - Balancing
notes.content:
Hey Guys. Romy and Lasse here to give you a little update. We've been listening to all your feedback and we've identified a couple of key areas that we wanted to improve on to make Hadleys Run more enjoyable and fulfilling to play.

Reducing the grind

Our focus is on making the game as fun as possible. The last thing we want you awesome players to feel is that the game is grindy and requires a lot of hard and boring work to unlock cool upgrades and feel progress. We respect your time and we don't want to waste it!

To address this we've lowered the cost of permanent upgrades across the board and reduced the cost of building portals that take you from one galaxy to the next. This should be a good starting point and we will continue to monitor this and make changes.

Fulfilling the power fantasy

We want players to get fun and impactful upgrades earlier! We want you to feel OP and bad-ass!

We have so many great upgrades that are unlocked by certain criteria (like killing a certain amount of enemies) but we found that our requirements were far too high. We've reduced those requirements significantly so that you can start rocking a kick ass arsenal sooner.

We also had certain restrictions that prevented certain legendary upgrades from appearing in certain galaxies. We've mostly removed those restrictions so that more powerful upgrades will appear sooner.

We've also slightly increased the chances for rare and legendary upgrades to appear after combat.

Future Changes

We're currently working on coming up with some creative new permanent upgrades that feel more impactful and allow players to feel a greater sense of progression.

We're also looking at creating some new upgrades. Variety is the spice of life.

Final Thoughts

Thank you all for your support and have a lovely week!

Full Change log

Balance Changes

- Reduced costs of permanent upgrades
- Wormholes can now be built sooner
- Increased chance of legendary upgrade after defeating a boss (32.5% -> 60%)
- Nexus Xyro wormhole construction cost reduced from 1000 -> 500
- New Jozi wormhole construction cost reduced from 1500 -> 750
- Increased the chance of getting a legendary upgrade by 50% (5% -> 7.5%)
- Increased the chance of getting a rare upgrade by 50% (10% -> 15%)
- Reduced requirements to unlock "Piercing Rounds" by 25%
- Reduced requirements to unlock "Triple Strike" by 25%
- Autonomous Force Legendary Upgrade can now be equipped earlier and is unlocked faster
- BFG now no longer requires Cluster Rockets
- BFG upgrade is now significantly easier to unlock
- Optimized Storage upgrade is now significantly easier to unlock
- Spray and Pray upgrade is now significantly easier to unlock
- Salvo Salvation upgrade will now drop in Ezstia.
- Mechanized Loading upgrade is now significantly easier to unlock
- Poisonous Squigly Acid Leeches upgrade is now significantly easier to unlock
- Plague Pulse upgrade will now drop in Ezstia.
- Plague Pulse upgrade is now significantly easier to unlock
- Ewww... Sticky upgrade buffed (slow from 10% -> 15%)
- Chain Reaction upgrade will now drop in Ezstia.
- Division By Zero upgrade buffed. Enemies are now slowed by 50% (instead of 15%)
- Living Steel upgrade will now drop in Ezstia.
- Equiping recklessness will no longer prevent the Engineering upgrade from appearing
- Rigid Frame upgrade buffed (from 15% reduction when colliding with enemy ships to 20% per level)
- Shake it off upgrade buffed (from 10% -> 15%)
- Yippee-Ki-Yay legendary upgrade buffed (will now trigger when below 30% instead of 25%)
- Backfoot Defence upgrade buffed slightly (duration from 2 seconds to 3 seconds)
- Get Out of Dodge upgrade buffed (cooldown reduced from 20 -> 10 seconds)
- Lightning Storm upgrade will now drop in Ezstia.
- Lightning Storm upgrade easier to unlock
- System Shock upgrade buffed (enemy slow from 20% -> 30%)

Bug Fixes

- Fixed bug with some PS5 controllers not showing glyphs correctly.
- Fixed loading bug when dying during the tutorial and then immediately quitting.

notes.title: Hadleys Run: Devlog and Update From the Team
notes.content:
Hello Everybody!!

Just a quick update from the team on our progress thus far and some announcements. I'll try keep it short and sweet.

Game Release
Our team has been working super hard to hit our release date at the end of July and so far so good! Everything is going really well and we're polishing up combat and scripting and doing all the final stuff we have to do to make the best game possible for all of you.

Achievements
Due to popular demand we've been working on some really cool achievements for all you perfectionists and 100%ers out there. We're aiming for around 30 achievements for now!

Events
We're also proud to announce that we are going to be a part of both The Endless Replayability Fest and Next Fest. So look out for us there and give our updated demo a spin. Speaking of... We'll be releasing an updated demo which contains not only the arcade but also a slice of our campaign for everyone to try out at the end of May. Exciting but also nerve-wracking for us!

A big thank you to all our supporters and all you awesome people out there. Have a lovely week!

notes.title: Hadley's Run - Arcade Demo Launch
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We've released an arcade demo to let you all try out some of our combat and mechanics. The arcade is a fast paced arena mode where you face hordes of enemies with a variety of weapon combinations in an attempt to set a high score.

Any feedback and improvements to the arcade combat and content will be added to the final game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914224/6be074701d10d83832a2a1a6300553998cd159cf.png

Arcade Features


 An arsenal of weapons to equip and unleash devastation with!
 Fast-paced, challenging combat.
 15 unique enemies to obliterate.
 90+ upgrades to install and experiment with, ensuring each attempt is unique.
 An infinite number of increasingly difficult levels, see how far you get!
 An ever changing environment, from black holes and solar winds to creepy space spiders.
 Full controller support.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914224/b81ac0f9cec6e21b30d5167692bac8b049704d29.png

We are still working on the arcade demo and the campaign and will be updating the build as we go. If you have any feedback please feel free to leave a review or a comment, we would really appreciate it and would absolutely love to hear from you!

You can get hold of us on twitter: https://twitter.com/UnsignedDoubleC or drop us an email: lasse@unsigneddouble.com


We will be giving away some Steam keys for the full game on launch day, so if you wanna join the fun just do the following:

👾 Follow us on twitter
✨ Tweet a screenshot of your high score and tag us.
🚀 You could be one of the lucky winners!

Please note that he arcade mode is a combat demo of the full game, Hadleys Run: A Starship Saga. This demo does not include any of the campaign or story mode.
